question: Should this Z.AI-only fix wait for live Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof, or may maintainers waive that proof gap because the source change is narrow and the canonical issue has live before-fix header evidence?
rationale: The remaining blocker is a proof-sufficiency and canonical-PR selection decision, not a code repair that automation can safely resolve.

options.title: Require Live Proof Or Waiver
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until a contributor or maintainer posts redacted live Coding Plan endpoint-detection output, or a maintainer explicitly waives that proof gap.

options.title: Accept Existing Source Proof
options.body: Treat the regression test plus the canonical issue's live before-fix evidence as enough and continue normal merge review for one selected branch.

options.title: Choose Another Candidate
options.body: Land a different narrow sibling PR for the same canonical issue and close this PR as superseded after that merge.
